scope: Eight newly authored prospective synthetic source-assessment cases (nine criteria), not third-party projects, customers, independent human users or a claim of unseen model training data. They cover contact-field presence, scoped negatives, inert decoys, cross-page owners, compound operations, quoted copy and merged-row meaning.
referenceMethod: Per-criterion source references and qualitative limits are authored and sealed before any provider answer for this cohort. Use the unchanged real production intake validation. Preserve first answers, raw/application differences and reference-policy disagreements; do not retune references after inspection.
